# @three-ws/vanity-mcp

> Read the three.ws vanity-address grind-bounty market and proof-of-grind rarity gallery from any AI agent. Quote a pattern's difficulty + USDC price, appraise any address's rarity, and browse the bounty board, claimable queue, stats, leaderboard, config, and gallery. Read-only — no key, no signer, no payment.

@three-ws/vanity-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/vanity-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/solana-vanity-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/solana-vanity-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/solana-vanity-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/solana-vanity-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
